description: This file contains helper functions, type definitions, and React components related to admin console features in Mattermost, including license checks, permission validations, and UI indicators for restricted features.

classes.name: ValidationResult
classes.description: A class used to represent validation results, indicating success or failure with associated messages.

methods.name: it.not
methods.description: Negates the result of a check function.

methods.name: it.all
methods.description: Returns true if all provided check functions pass.

methods.name: it.any
methods.description: Returns true if any of the provided check functions pass.

methods.name: it.stateMatches
methods.description: Checks if a state value matches a regex.

methods.name: it.stateEquals
methods.description: Checks if a state value equals a specified value.

methods.name: it.stateEqualsOrDefault
methods.description: Checks if a state value equals a specified value or defaults.

methods.name: it.stateIsTrue
methods.description: Checks if a state value is truthy.

methods.name: it.stateIsFalse
methods.description: Checks if a state value is falsy.

methods.name: it.configIsTrue
methods.description: Checks if a config setting is true.

methods.name: it.configIsFalse
methods.description: Checks if a config setting is false.

methods.name: it.configContains
methods.description: Checks if a config setting contains a specific word.

methods.name: it.enterpriseReady
methods.description: Determines if the configuration is enterprise ready.

methods.name: it.licensed
methods.description: Checks if the license is marked as licensed.

methods.name: it.cloudLicensed
methods.description: Checks if the license is a cloud license.

methods.name: it.licensedForFeature
methods.description: Checks if the license is licensed for a specific feature.

methods.name: it.licensedForSku
methods.description: Checks if the license matches a specific SKU.

methods.name: it.minLicenseTier
methods.description: Checks if the license tier is at least a specified level.

methods.name: it.licensedForCloudStarter
methods.description: Checks if the license is for Cloud Starter SKU.

methods.name: it.hidePaymentInfo
methods.description: Determines if payment info should be hidden based on cloud subscription.

methods.name: it.userHasReadPermissionOnResource
methods.description: Checks if user has read permission on a resource.

methods.name: it.userHasReadPermissionOnSomeResources
methods.description: Checks if user has read permission on any resource in a set.

methods.name: it.userHasWritePermissionOnResource
methods.description: Checks if user has write permission on a resource.

methods.name: it.isSystemAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the user is a system admin.

methods.name: validators.isRequired
methods.description: Validates that a value is provided.

methods.name: validators.minValue
methods.description: Validates that a number is at least a minimum.

methods.name: validators.maxValue
methods.description: Validates that a number does not exceed a maximum.

methods.name: usesLegacyOauth
methods.description: Determines if legacy OAuth configurations are used based on settings.

methods.name: getRestrictedIndicator
methods.description: Returns a React component and display logic for restricted feature indicators based on cloud subscription status.
